item.title: Ukraine war latest: SBU releases greatest hits video of 2025 drone strikes on Russian aircraft
item.description: Live coverage of Russia’s war against Ukraine with breaking news and frontline updates, updated 8 times today. Ukraine's Security Service (SBU) on Jan. 28 released a video compilation of what it claimed was the destruction of more than $1 billion worth of Russian military aircraft in long-range drone strikes conducted by its Alpha special forces unit.

item.title: Exclusive: Trump's top envoy negotiating Ukraine's fate displays 'shocking' lack of knowledge about war, politics
item.description: A senior U.S. envoy involved in efforts to end Russia's full-scale war against Ukraine has displayed a lack of basic understanding of Ukraine's political system and the war itself while speaking in a closed conversation with a small group of reporters, the Kyiv Independent has

item.title: Casualties, damage to infrastructure reported as Russia launches missiles, drones at various regions of Ukraine
item.description: Russian forces launched missile and drone attacks on several Ukrainian regions, including Kyiv and surrounding areas, overnight on Jan. 28, local authorities reported.

item.title: 'They don't consider their work heroic' — 4 energy workers die amid Kyiv repairs following Russian attacks
item.description: As Kyiv's repair crews scramble to keep the lights and heat on after repeated Russian strikes, the work has become punishing — and, in recent weeks, deadly.Oleksandr Pitaichuk, a 31-year-old high-angle rescuer, died during emergency repair work at one of Kyiv's power facilities on Jan.

item.title: Germany's Merz says Ukraine joining EU in 2027 'not possible'
item.description: The comments come after President Volodymyr Zelensky set 2027 as the target date for Ukraine's entry into the bloc.

item.title: Lukoil agrees to sell most of its foreign assets to US investment group
item.description: The Carlyle deal does not include Lukoil's assets in Kazakhstan and is still subject to approval by the U.S. Treasury Department, the Russian energy giant said.

item.title: Ukraine repatriates bodies of 1,000 fallen soldiers
item.description: Russia confirmed that it had handed over 1,000 bodies to Ukraine under the Istanbul agreement in exchange for 38 bodies of fallen Russian soldiers, Kremlin-controlled news agency TASS reported on Jan. 29.

item.title: Ukraine war latest live: Russian aircraft, radar station, drone control centres destroyed in multiple attacks, General Staff says
item.description: Live coverage of Russia’s war against Ukraine with breaking news and frontline updates, updated 6 times today. Ukrainian forces struck several Russian military targets, including an aircraft, the General Staff said on Jan. 29.

item.title: Ukraine's central bank cuts interest rate in first change in 10 months
item.description: The National Bank of Ukraine (NBU) voted on Jan. 29 to cut its benchmark interest rate to 15%, the first change since March last year, as inflation cools and a new aid package from Europe eased pressure on the country's finances.
